text:
Before: steamed vegetables (green beans, snap peas, broccoli, carrots, cauliflower) of about 200 g, mixed green salad of about 60 g with no visible dressing, and roasted chicken (skin on, shredded) of about 120 g. Water is not counted.

After: the vegetable bowl has some green beans and carrots left, about 50 g. The salad plate and chicken plate are essentially empty, apart from a few scraps.

Eaten:
- Vegetables: about 150 g at roughly 40 kcal per 100 g = 60 kcal.
- Salad: about 60 g at roughly 20 kcal per 100 g = 12 kcal.
- Chicken: about 120 g with skin at roughly 200 kcal per 100 g = 240 kcal. Some of the chicken may be skinless meat, so this could run a bit lower. I'll use about 215 kcal for 110 g.

Total: about 60 + 12 + 215 = 287 kcal, and about 150 + 60 + 110 = 320 g.
